name: Classical Myth in Art
intro: Works from an Athenian wine cup to a Paris studio, each with one thing to look for.
homeDescription: How to recognize the Greek and Roman myths in art, from Exekias and the Venus de Milo to Titian, Rubens, Ingres and Turner.
ldDescription: A short guide to recognizing classical myth in art, about 530 BCE to 1890, compiled from museum collection records.
